'''Jacob "Jaap" Korevaar''' (25 January 1923 – 18 March 2025) was a Dutch mathematician. He was part of the faculty of the [[University of California San Diego]] and [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]], as well as the [[University of Amsterdam]] ([[Korteweg-de Vries Institute for Mathematics]]).

Korevaar became a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1975.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4396 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160208203310/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4396 |title=Jaap Korevaar |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=8 February 2016 |accessdate=8 February 2016}}</ref> He won the 1987 [[Lester Randolph Ford Award|Lester R. Ford Award]], and the 1989 [[Chauvenet Prize]], for an essay on [[Louis de Branges de Bourcia]]'s proof of the [[Bieberbach conjecture]].<ref>''[[Ludwig Bieberbach]]'s Conjecture and Its Proof by Louis de Branges'', [[American Mathematical Monthly]], Vol. 93, 1986, pp. 505–514 [http://www.maa.org/programs/maa-awards/writing-awards/ludwig-bieberbachs-conjecture-and-its-proof-by-louis-de-branges online text] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201024092052/https://www.maa.org/programs/maa-awards/writing-awards/ludwig-bieberbachs-conjecture-and-its-proof-by-louis-de-branges |date=24 October 2020 }}</ref> In 2012, he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 7 July 2013.</ref>

Korevaar was the older brother of the Olympic [[water polo]] player [[Nijs Korevaar]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20140107033546/http://www.gjkorevaar.nl/Korevaar_Nijs_Cornelia_Wepster.htm gjkorevaar.nl]</ref> He died in [[Bussum]] on 18 March 2025, at the age of 102.<ref>[https://images.nrc.nl/rSVYQl4v3uNPBROFtxF7IVEuF2A=/filters:no_upscale():format(jpeg):fill(f8f8f8,true)/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20250322/430-advertisement-284440_1337070_korevaar01-9b47f6.png newspaper announcement NRC 22 maart 2025]</ref><ref name="r987">{{cite web | title=In Memoriam: Jacob (Jaap) Korevaar | website=Department of Mathematics University of Wisconsin – Madison | date=21 March 2025 | url=https://math.wisc.edu/2025/03/21/in-memoriam-jacob-jaap-korevaar/ | access-date=22 March 2025}}</ref>
